claims.summary: In the setting of lem:separated-bundle-chains (its events at kappa = 4, 4 sqrt(log N/N) <= delta_0 <= 2^(-l_1), (4,4), a nested chain g = delta_0 sum_{k <= K} y_k 1_{A_k} with heights in [2e^16, V], K arbitrary, discrete cost at most 2), with bundles b each a monotone lattice path Gamma_b of grid length l_b (after a reflection going up and right, inner side above), tau_b = (-delta_0, delta_0), band i the cells whose centre is gamma + (i + 1/2) tau_b for a lattice point gamma of Gamma_b, and a group t_b < k <= t_b + m_b of total height Y_b, such that (B1) every edge of Gamma_b lies on exactly the group's boundaries, (B2) the strip of bands 0..m_b lies in A_{t_b+m_b} minus A_{t_b+m_b+1}, (B3) the strips are pairwise disjoint, (B4) l_b >= max(2^(-l_1), 4 m_b delta_0 (log Y_b)^(1/4)): |D(g)| <= C sqrt(N log N)(1 + (log V)^(1/4) + eta_W), eta_W the cost-weighted log of the edges with increment above V on no Gamma_b, C universal.
claims.assessment: Working proof, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_staircase_bundles_20261017/review.txt): lem:separated-bundle-chains' proof with depth rows replaced by bands defined by cell centres at half-integer diagonal distances from the path, which make the translates edge-disjoint with consecutive bands on each translate edge's sides (one lattice point per anti-diagonal on a monotone path); 4 m_b side edges at the two ends; the remainder within l-infinity distance m_b delta_0 of the path, meeting at most 9(l_b/W_b + 3) half-open cells of side W_b.
claims.rationale: Removes the straightness of lem:separated-bundle-chains, so that bundles may turn at every cell; uniformly over its class, which the recorded uniform chain bounds and the band clauses (full-width bands along graphs of bounded slope) do not cover. Its witness, one fixed function, is decided by Chebyshev and shows only that the class has members with many layers on turning bundles; the witness's own-guides argument through lem:guided-chain-bound (d) does not extend to the class.
claims.next_action: Stacks of lines too close to spread, as ramps: a band bound localized to a finite monotone path with its within-cell term; the residue's cell-function part by per-cell counts.
